description: §6.8.4 — `tare()` with no argument is E-TARE-NO-ARG (compile error, §34). The `tare` keyword takes `tare(@cell)` or `tare(@cell, <expr>)`; a bare call names no cell and therefore no default slot to write.
rationale: §6.8.4 requires an explicit cell argument, mirroring §6.8.2's E-RESET-NO-ARG. The diagnostic is attached at parse time by the expression-parser when the `tare(...)` call is lifted into a `tare-expr` node, and surfaced by the ast-builder wrapper — the same surfacing route the reset sibling uses. E-RESET-NO-ARG must NOT fire: the codes are per-keyword so a message never names a keyword the author did not write.
